name: smwmusic-tetris-attack-staff-roll
title: Tetris Attack - Staff Roll
description:
A very calm and happy song played at the credits screen.

02/28 Update: Added an option to loop the song at the start, in case you want to use it in a level. If you want to do so, then open the text file, and change the "Level_Version" define to 1.
(Also, by using this alternative version, it decays the insert size to 0x0AC6 bytes)
